architecture.completion_authority_model: AuthoritativeCompletionGate is the sole gatekeeper for terminal GOAL_COMPLETED emission across the entire AstraRun runtime.

registration_lifecycle.entry_point: GoalPlanner.parse_goal generates GoalContract with acceptance predicates.
registration_lifecycle.telemetry_registration: CausalTelemetry.register_contract registers contract with AuthoritativeCompletionGate under active run_id and task_id.
registration_lifecycle.loop_execution: AgentExecutionEngine.execute_goal and run_task propagate GoalContract to task.contract and register it.
registration_lifecycle.exit_point: AstraApplication.handle_request passes contract from res.task to telemetry.end_run.
registration_lifecycle.cleanup: telemetry.end_run automatically unregisters contract upon run termination to prevent cross-run/cross-task leakage.

success_path.condition: status == 'SUCCESS' AND AuthoritativeCompletionGate.can_complete(...) returns can_complete == True with verdict APPROVED

termination_failure_path.condition: status != 'SUCCESS' OR AuthoritativeCompletionGate.can_complete(...) returns can_complete == False with verdict REJECTED

terminal_semantics.direct_emission_blocking: Direct emission of GOAL_COMPLETED with non-SUCCESS status or unapproved gate evaluation is strictly rejected and dropped.

call_graph_nodes.purpose: Constructs contract and derives acceptance predicates from user utterance
Hands res.task.contract to end_run upon request completion
Authoritatively evaluates mandatory predicate satisfaction before emitting GOAL_COMPLETED
Removes run/task contract mapping upon run termination

invariants_enforced: No goal may complete without an explicit GoalContract containing mandatory acceptance predicates.
Every required predicate must have run-scoped affirmative physical evidence.
Missing, pending, or unknown predicates fail closed.
Stale evidence or mismatched run/task IDs fail closed.
Requested presentation requires verified physical observation (RESULT_PRESENTED).
Cleanups must not be in FAILED_CLEANUP state.
Non-SUCCESS terminations emit RUN_TERMINATED, never GOAL_COMPLETED.
Contracts do not leak across runs or tasks.
